facts.fact: The National Identification Card was created by the State through Decree-Law 19/2014 and is compulsory for all Cabo Verdean citizens from age 4, with applications taking 7 to 15 days, per the Consular Portal.
The Consular Portal says the National Identification Card (CNI) can be ordered online with photo and signature captured, a normal order costing 14 euro and an urgent one 20 euro.

facts.fact: IMIJ states SNIAC has contributed to issuing about 631,720 national identity cards (CNI), 513,862 electronic passports and 14,235 residence permits since its implementation.
IMIJ's project page says the SNIAC national identification system is operational and issues the national ID card (215,189 issued by Q2 2021), the e-passport and the foreign residents' permit.
